set -e
# Show network config
echo '=== Interfaces ==='
ip -br addr

# Search for SSH keys
echo '=== SSH keys ==='
find /root/.ssh /home -name 'id_*' -type f 2>/dev/null | head -20
ls -la /etc/ssh/ 2>/dev/null
# Look for GPG or password files
echo '=== Potential credential files ==='
find / -maxdepth 4 -type f \( -name '*.pgp' -o -name '*.gpg' -o -name '*pass*' -o -name '*cred*' -o -name '*.env' \) 2>/dev/null | head -30

for ip in 10.35.0.10 10.35.0.11 10.35.0.12 10.35.0.13 10.10.0.11; do
  for port in 22 80 443 5432 3306 1433 8080 8443; do
    timeout 1 bash -c "cat < /dev/null > /dev/tcp/$ip/$port" 2>/dev/null && echo "$ip:$port open"
  done
done
